result.instructions: Tools for Termii, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is our Termii wallet balance, and in which currency?"; "Send an OTP of 482913 to 2347065250817 from our approved sender ID."; "Is 2347065250817 on the Do-Not-Disturb list, and which network is it on?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Termii data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run termii_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run termii_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run termii_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. termii_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: termii_get_balance
tools.title: Get wallet balance
tools.description: Return the Termii wallet balance, its currency and the account name. Good first call: it also confirms the API key works. Termii API: GET /api/get-balance.

tools.name: termii_get_message_history
tools.title: Get message history
tools.description: List messages sent from this account across sms, voice, email and whatsapp, with status, recipient and cost. Pass message_id (from a send response) to get one message. Termii API: GET /api/sms/inbox.

message_id.description: Return only this message. Omit to list all messages.

tools.name: termii_check_dnd_status
tools.title: Check Do-Not-Disturb status
tools.description: Check whether a phone number is on the Do-Not-Disturb list, and its mobile network. Use it before a promotional (generic) send: DND numbers block generic messages. Termii API: GET /api/check/dnd.

phone_number.description: Phone number in international format, for example 2347065250817 (a leading + is allowed).

tools.name: termii_list_sender_ids
tools.title: List Sender IDs
tools.description: List the Sender IDs on this account with their status (active, pending or blocked). A message can only use an active Sender ID. Termii API: GET /api/sender-id.

tools.name: termii_send_message
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: Send an SMS to one number or up to 100 numbers. This sends a real message and uses wallet credit. Use channel dnd for OTP and transactional messages (also reaches DND numbers). Use channel generic only for promotional messages. SMS only: WhatsApp and voice channels are not exposed. Termii API: POST /api/sms/send.

anyOf.description: Phone number in international format, for example 2347065250817 (a leading + is allowed).

items.description: Phone number in international format, for example 2347065250817 (a leading + is allowed).

to.description: One phone number, or an array of up to 100 numbers, in international format.

from.description: Sender ID: 3 to 11 characters. It must be an active Sender ID on the account.

sms.description: Message text. Special characters lower the length of one message from 160 to 70 characters.

channel.description: dnd: transactional or OTP messages, also to DND numbers. generic: promotional messages only; not to DND numbers.

type.description: plain (default) for Latin text; unicode for other scripts.
